chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ibn Sinān, from al-Ḥusayn al-Qalānisī, who said:
I wrote to Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام asking him about al-fuqqāʿ, so he said: “Do not go near it, for indeed it is from wine.”

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّ: the Imam addressed in the written question
key_terms.الْخَمْرِ: wine/intoxicant, used here to classify the drink as prohibited
key_terms.الْفُقَّاعِ: a fermented drink asked about in the narration
key_terms.كَتَبْتُ: I wrote, indicating the question was sent in writing
key_terms.لَا تَقْرَبْهُ: a direct prohibition not to approach or consume it

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام say about al-fuqqāʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal response from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام concerning al-fuqqāʿ. He forbids approaching it and classifies it as being from khamr, indicating its prohibition within jurisprudential discussion of intoxicants.
